question: Peer Ali Khan was a prominent figure in the 1857 Revolt who organized rebels and challenged British rule in which major city of Bihar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Patna**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Peer Ali Khan** was one of the prominent leaders of the **1857 Revolt** in India, also known as the First War of Independence.
 
• He played a significant role in organizing the rebels and challenging British rule in the city of **Patna**, which was a crucial center of resistance during the uprising.
 
• **Patna**, located in the modern-day state of Bihar, served as a hotbed of revolutionary activities under the leadership of Peer Ali Khan.
 
• Peer Ali Khan was known for his **underground networks** that disseminated anti-British sentiments and mobilized local support against colonial rule.<
